lines.translation: He does whatever He pleases.
No one has done, or can do anything by himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee dar saachai pat paaee he ||16||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Name, one is blessed with glorious greatness, and obtains honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||16||3||
Maaroo, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo aaiaa so sabh ko jaasee ||
lines.translation: All who come shall have to depart.
In the love of duality, they are caught by the noose of the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur raakhe se jan ubare saache saach samaaee he ||1||
lines.translation: Those humble beings who are protected by the True Guru, are saved. They merge into the Truest of the True. ||1||
The Creator Himself creates the creation, and watches over it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar kare soee jan lekhai ||
lines.translation: Thay alone are acceptable, upon whom He bestows His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh giaan tis sabh kichh soojhai agiaanee a(n)dh kamaaee he ||2||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh attains spiritual wisdom, and understands everything. The ignorant ones act blindly. ||2||
The self-willed manmukh is cynical; he doesn't understand.
He dies and dies again, only to be reborn, and loses his life uselessly again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam rate sukh paaiaa sahaje saach samaaee he ||3||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he find peace, and is intuitively immersed in the True Lord. ||3||
Chasing after worldly affairs, the mind has become corroded and rusty.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: phir hovai ka(n)chan bhetai gur pooraa ||
lines.translation: But meeting with the Perfect Guru, it is transmuted into gold once again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhas lae sukh paae poorai sabad milaaee he ||4||
lines.translation: When the Lord Himself grants forgiveness, then peace is obtained; through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, one is united with Him. ||4||
The false and evil-minded are the most wicked of the wicked.
They are the most unworthy of the unworthy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਚੀ ਮਤਿ ਫੀਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kachee mat pheekaa mukh bolai duramat naam na paaee he ||5||
lines.translation: With false intellect, and insipid words of mouth, evil-minded, they do not obtain the Naam. ||5||
The unworthy soul-bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord.
False-minded, her actions are false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: pir kaa saau na jaanai moorakh bin gur boojh na paaee he ||6||
lines.translation: The foolish person does not know the excellence of her Husband Lord. Without the Guru, she does not understand at all. ||6||
The evil-minded, wicked soul-bride practices wickedness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਰ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: seegaar kare pir khasam na bhaavai ||
lines.translation: She decorates herself, but her Husband Lord is not pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gunava(n)tee sadaa pir raavai satigur mel milaaee he ||7||
lines.translation: The virtuous soul-bride enjoys and ravishes her Husband Lord forever; the True Guru unites her in His Union. ||7||
God Himself issues the Hukam of His Command, and beholds all.
Some are forgiven, according to their pre-ordained destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: anadin naam rate sach paaiaa aape mel milaaee he ||8||
lines.translation: Night and day, they are imbued with the Naam, and they find the True Lord. He Himself unites them in His Union. ||8||
Egotism attaches them to the juice of emotional attachment, and makes them run around.
The Gurmukh is intuitively immersed in the True Love of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: aape melai aape kar vekhai bin satigur boojh na paaee he ||9||
lines.translation: He Himself unites, He Himself acts, and beholds. Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik sabad veechaar sadaa jan jaage ||
lines.translation: Some contemplate the Word of the Shabad; these humble beings remain always awake and aware.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik maaiaa mohi soi rahe abhaage ||
lines.translation: Some are attached to the love of Maya; these unfortunate ones remain asleep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: aape kare karaae aape hor karanaa kichhoo na jaaee he ||10||
lines.translation: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act; no one else can do anything. ||10||
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, death is conquered and killed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam rakhai ur dhaare ||
lines.translation: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined within your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevaa te sukh paaiaa har kai naam samaaee he ||11||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained, and one merges in the Name of the Lord. ||11||
In the love of duality, the world wanders around insane.
Immersed in love and attachment to Maya, it suffers in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਨਹ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: bahute bhekh karai nah paae bin satigur sukh na paaee he ||12||
lines.translation: Wearing all sorts of religious robes, He is not obtained. Without the True Guru, peace is not found. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kis no kaheeai jaa aap karaae ||
lines.translation: Who is to blame, when He Himself does everything?
As He wills, so is the path we take.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: aape miharavaan sukhadaataa jiu bhaavai tivai chalaaee he ||13||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Merciful Giver of peace; as He wills, so do we follow. ||13||
He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.
He Himself is detached, and He Himself is attached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: aape niramal miharavaan madhusoodan jis daa hukam na metiaa jaaee he ||14||
lines.translation: He Himself is immaculate, compassionate, the lover of nectar; the Hukam of His Command cannot be erased. ||14||
Those who know the One Lord are very fortunate.
